task.summary: Transforming a subject whose wildcard source token is missing panics with an index out of range instead of substituting an empty token.
task.instructions: Fix the defect in the server package so the failing regression test passes without modifying any test.
task.acceptance_notes: FAIL_TO_PASS must pass; do not edit *_test.go.

code_fault.description: TransformTokenizedSubject indexes tokens for a Wildcard mapping without bounds checking, so a missing source token causes an index out of range panic.

ops_fault.description: Applying a subject transform with a wildcard mapping panics the server when an incoming subject is missing the referenced token.
localization_keywords: tokens slice indexed without bounds check
repair_keywords: guard wildcard token index against slice length
skip writing when token is missing
substitute empty token instead of panicking

visible_context.issue_text: When a subject transform uses a wildcard mapping and an incoming subject is shorter than expected, the server panics instead of completing the transform.
error_logs: panic: runtime error: index out of range [1] with length 1
recovered panic while applying subject transform mapping
